item.banya_hat.desc: A felt cap: the head keeps cool in the steam room.
item.banya_hat.name: Banya hat
item.banya_towel.desc: A terry towel. A rub-down after the ice hole and you're warm at once.
item.banya_towel.name: Towel
item.birch_venik.desc: A bunch of birch twigs steeped in hot water. Good for one banya day.
item.birch_venik.name: Birch whisk
item.carrot.desc: A carrot. You can eat it, or give a snowman a nose.
item.carrot.name: Carrot
item.coal.desc: Two bits of coal from the banya stove. Just right for a snowman's eyes.
item.coal.name: Bits of coal
item.skates.desc: “Snegurochka” leisure skates on leather boots. Put them on and go to the pond.
item.skates.name: Skates
winter.banya.closed: The banya isn't heated today. It's heated Wednesdays, Fridays and weekends, from two.
winter.banya.coal: The banya keeper slipped me a coal from the stove: “For a snowman's eyes”.
winter.banya.enter.1: Up onto the top shelf. The wood is hot.
winter.banya.enter.2: The heat wraps round at once; breathe slowly.
winter.banya.enter.3: The steam room smells of linden and a little smoke.
winter.banya.faint: Everything goes dark... the banya keeper walks me out into the air.
winter.banya.no_money: Entry is {0} rub., and my pocket holds less.
winter.banya.no_venik: No birch whisk. They sell them at the door.
winter.banya.out_sea: Steam rolls off my shoulders. The sea is two steps away.
winter.banya.out_snow: Steam rolls off my shoulders. Now, into the snow!
winter.banya.prompt_door: E — into the banya ({0} rub.) · T — birch whisks and hats
winter.banya.prompt_steam: E — pour on the stones · Space — go out
winter.banya.prompt_steam_venik: E — pour on the stones · G — the birch whisk · Space — go out
winter.banya.round: Round {0}: the heat and the cold, as it should be.
winter.banya.snow.2: My skin hisses like the stones on the stove.
winter.banya.snow.3: Lying in a snowdrift, and I'm hot.
winter.banya.steam.1: Hiss! The steam hits the ceiling.
winter.banya.steam.3: The stones answer with steam; it smells of birch.
winter.banya.too_hot: Too hot. Time to go out.
winter.fight.hit_me.1: Got me! Right down the collar!
winter.fight.hit_me.3: Snow in my ear. This is war!
winter.fight.join.1: “Snowballs!” The children run to pack some.
winter.fight.join.2: One of the children is already aiming at me.
winter.fight.join.3: “They're hitting ours!” Another one runs up.
winter.fight.score: Snowballs: I hit {0}, they hit me {1}
winter.radio.new_year: Happy New Year, Lyudmilovsk! The walruses wait for everyone brave by the pier until one o'clock.
winter.radio.rink_open: The rink on the seaside park's pond is open: the ice is {0} centimetres. Skates at the department store's sports counter.
winter.radio.rink_slush: A thaw: there is water over the ice at the park rink, and the rink is closed.
winter.radio.rink_thin: The ice on the park pond is still thin, {0} centimetres. Please keep off it.
winter.radio.walrus: The walruses' club invites you: tomorrow at nine, a swim in the ice hole by the pier. The banya by the pier is heated from two.
winter.skate.fall.3: That turn was sharper than the edge could hold.
winter.skate.fall.4: Sitting on the ice. At least nobody was looking.
winter.skate.fall.5: Getting up. A wet knee, and wet pride.
winter.skate.first: I'm off! A push, and a glide.
winter.skate.long_glide: A long glide, half the pond.
winter.snow.too_cold: The snow is dry as sand: it won't pack in this frost.
winter.snow.too_thin: Too little snow to fill a palm.
winter.snowman.done: A snowman! Three balls, as it should be.
winter.snowman.dressed: He looks at me with coal eyes. Done.
winter.snowman.prompt_lift: E — lift the ball on top ({0} cm)
winter.snowman.prompt_nose: E — a carrot for a nose
winter.snowman.prompt_too_big: The ball is too big to lift ({0} cm)
winter.snowman.too_big: Can't lift it. The top ball has to be smaller than the one under it.
winter.snowman.want_carrot: He needs a carrot for a nose (the market).
winter.snowman.want_coal: He needs coals for eyes (the banya keeper may have some).
winter.walrus.cold: My fingers won't obey. Time to get out!
winter.walrus.hauled: The walruses hauled me onto the pier and rubbed me down with a towel.
winter.walrus.new_year: Happy New Year! The year's first swim, in the ice hole.
winter.walrus.towel: The towel, and at once it's warmer.
